title: Go Down, Moses
attribution: African-American spiritual from the time of slavery, first printed as sheet music in 1861-62 ("Oh! Let My People Go") and in the Fisk Jubilee Singers' Jubilee Songs (1872), whose first verse and refrain are used here. Anonymous and traditional, public domain worldwide. The D sharp on "people" is the raised leading note of the minor key and is expected to show as out-of-key.
